name: QA Multi Screen Cap
description: Take multiple screenshots — visible page, drag-selected area, or your saved area — at screen, 2× or 3× quality; keep the last 10 in a small floating window, and drag or copy-paste them into Excel or the workstation.
features: 🔍 Quality setting: Auto (screen), 2× HD or 3× Ultra — higher-resolution rendering so captures stay crisp when enlarged in Excel or the test plan
🗔 Small floating window that stays open while you work — the gallery lives there
🖱 Drag any thumbnail straight into Excel, a folder, or the workstation's 📎 chat box
📋 One-click copy, then paste (Ctrl/Cmd+V) into Excel, Word, chats…
✂️ Drag-select a capture area once — it's saved, so ↻ / Alt+Shift+A re-captures the same spot with no dragging
📸 Visible-page capture (Alt+Shift+F); all shortcuts changeable via the ⌨️ button
🔟 Keeps the last 10 captures across pages and tabs (oldest drops off); 💾 saves them all into Downloads/screencaps/
🔗 Drag a thumbnail into the test case builder's 🖼 Evidence cell to attach it to a case
